objective: Allow existing editor asset import and animation tooling to access internal runtime helpers without public APIs
chosenApproach: Friend access to Unity predefined Editor assembly, not other player assemblies
selectionRationale: Source audit found editor calls to internal CombatMotionRhythm and ReviewWeaponTrail helpers; existing runtime asmdef only grants test assembly access.
alternativeApproaches: Make all internal runtime helpers public; rejected.
preserveBehaviors: No runtime game or release changes
acceptanceChecks: Editor source can reference internal helpers across assembly boundary
